overview: A lion dance troupe performs at an outdoor competition or festival broadcast on HTV Thể Thao. A white, ornate lion costume operated by two performers cautiously approaches a series of numbered high steel poles set above blue safety crash mats on a green stage. In the background stands an elevated stage featuring a large video display screen, a decorative golden dragon sculpture, and an official judging table. A picture-in-picture inset in the lower-right corner shows the accompanying percussion team playing a large barrel drum and cymbals to a fast, driving rhythm.
